messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT 1761234567 - sudden spike in 503s from hosted inference gateway detected (30m window)
monitoring-bot: service=hosted-inference-gateway, upstream_pool=gpu-pool-us-east-2, symptom=upstream worker exits (SIGSEGV/CUDA OOM) -> kube restarts -> client 503s

support_jamie: filing this for customer C-52342 (AcmePay). They report checkout API calls returning 503s between ~11:34-11:45 UTC, lots of client retries. Customer wants ETA and SLO credit info.

sre_mike: investigating. Pulling worker logs and node metrics now. Will post findings.
sre_mike: quick glanceshow: repeated container restarts, kernel OOM kills referencing GPU, occasional segfaults in runtime (libtorch). Can we get the exact sample request and headers from AcmePay?

support_jamie: they attached a payload. Using text-generation endpoint with batch_size=8, max_tokens=2048, streaming=false. Constant QPS ~4, bursts up to 12. Auth via token; we do see some 401->retry patterns but main problem is 503 gateway responses.

eng-runtime-alex: pasting relevant worker tail logs:
```
[2026-03-15T11:36:14Z] worker[pid=2241] ERROR runtime: segfault at 0x7f4b9c in attention kernel
[2026-03-15T11:36:14Z] worker[pid=2241] ERROR runtime: backtrace ... libtorch symbols ...
[2026-03-15T11:36:15Z] host kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2241 (inference) total-vm: 12345678kB, anon-rss: 11234567kB
[2026-03-15T11:36:15Z] host kernel: NVRM: Xid 31: GPU page fault while address translation
[2026-03-15T11:36:16Z] kubelet: Killing container docker://inf-worker-2241: failed liveness probe
```
eng-runtime-alex: looks like a CUDA OOM followed by a segfault. Noting the model tag in the pod env: mirrored/rdw-vicuna-16b-q4-2026:v2.4.1-quant

eng-ml-sara: we rolled a quantization change to that tag last night. Internal perf tests showed small memory regressions but not at this magnitude. Hypothesis: rare long-context inputs expanding KV cache and multiplying memory footprint on quantized kernels.

infra-luis: node telemetry shows GPU memory at ~98% right before crash. No swap configured for GPU. Autoscaler did spawn extra nodes but pods failed immediately and churned, causing scheduler pressure -> upstream 503s at the gateway.

sre_mike: immediate mitigations proposed:
- override routing for AcmePay to route away from gpu-pool-us-east-2 to a healthy pool (us-east-1)
- prepare rollback to v2.4.0-quant for the affected model tag
- tune pod restart backoff and isolate noisy nodes to prevent cascade

sre_mike: applying route override for AcmePay now.

deploy-bot: Route override action: selector=customer:acmepay status=PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS

sre_mike: also temporarily scale up gpu-pool-us-east-2 by +3 nodes to relieve pressure while we investigate (short-term)

eng-runtime-alex: digging deeper in worker traces: a single AcmePay request had multiple concatenated docs; estimated effective sequence length ~9200 tokens, KV cache ballooned. The quantized runtime path did not trim prefixes for this model variant, so memory accounting underestimated live KV size.

eng-ml-sara: that matches: quantized attention implementation has a different KV packing behaviour. Under long contexts the per-token memory multiplier increases. If we can reproduce locally we'll push a guard to cap context for quantized tag.

support_jamie: customer reports partial recovery after traffic diversion but intermittent 503s persist. They want logs and a timeline for an RCA.

customer-success-kate: drafting a customer update: mention diversion to alternate pool, rollback plan, and offer of SLO credit. Need ETA for rollback or patch.

eng-runtime-alex: repro plan posted:
1) run AcmePay payload with batch_size=8, max_tokens=2048 but craft prompt to reach ~9000 tokens context
2) run against v2.4.1-quant in staging pool with debug flags and nvcrash enabled
3) capture dmesg, nvcrash, and runtime traces

eng-ml-sara: spinning up sandbox repro now. If we can trigger the OOM offline we can implement two fixes: a guard that rejects >8192 token contexts for quantized tag, and a memory-accounting patch to the KV allocator. Patch ETA ~4 hours for minimal guard + tests. Full allocator fix longer.

infra-luis: adding a temporary deployment knob: reject_large_context=true for mirrored/rdw-vicuna-16b-q4-2026:v2.4.1-quant and will gate it by customer selector until patch is landed.

sre_mike: ops checklist update:
- traffic diverted for AcmePay -> done
- pool scaled -> done
- rollback candidate v2.4.0-quant prepared -> queued
- CS notified re: SLO credit -> underway

support_jamie: customer requests immediate rollback if instability persists. Can we fast-track?

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: selector=customer:acmepay -> model_tag=v2.4.0-quant job_id=98432

eng-runtime-alex: note that rollback will change perf characteristics for some workloads but should reduce memory usage and avoid the OOM path. Recommend controlled canary rollback.

eng-ml-sara: patch ETA remains ~4 hours for guard + perf regressions. Rollback is lower risk to restore stability quickly.

deploy-bot: Rollback job 98432: status IN_PROGRESS -> SUCCESS (v2.4.0-quant active for selector customer:acmepay)

sre_mike: post-rollback metrics: error rate for AcmePay dropped to baseline within ~2 minutes, no further GPU OOMs observed on us-east-2 since rollback.

customer-success-kate: AcmePay acknowledged rollback and will continue monitoring. They've requested a final RCA and timeline for a safe redeploy.

eng-ml-sara: plan to run extended heavy-context staging tests after patch. Current ETA: 4 hours to implement guard + 2 hours for staged verification, then a canary redeploy if green.

support_jamie: collecting artifacts for ticket C-52342 (headers, payload, response traces) to attach to customer note.

sre_mike: long-term actions to prevent recurrence:
- automatic context-length rejection for quantized model variants
- memory-per-token regression alerts across releases
- monitor NVidia Xid errors and surface them in incident alerts
- stricter canary gating for quantized rollouts by context-length buckets

eng-runtime-alex: provisional root cause chain: (1) new quantized model variant deployed -> (2) unusually long-context requests hit quantized KV path -> (3) KV growth multiplied memory usage -> (4) CUDA OOM -> (5) process segfault -> (6) kubelet restarts pods -> (7) gateway returns 503s to customers.

sre_mike: marking incident P1 for 1 hour. We'll update when postmortem is complete. Tag the thread if you see Xid 31/43/45 errors escalating.

monitoring-bot: route override applied successfully; AcmePay traffic now served from gpu-pool-us-east-1 (proxy latency delta +2ms).

support_jamie: updating AcmePay: traffic diverted and rollback executed; will confirm once customer verifies stability.

deploy-bot: Rollback job 98432: FINAL_STATUS=SUCCESS

sre_mike: closing notes: incident resolved after routing + rollback. Follow-up: implement guard, extend perf alerts, and document canary policy changes.

monitoring-bot: INCIDENT 1761234567 -> RESOLVED (routing + rollback applied)
